metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products. MODIS Terra (MOD14A1) or FIRMS data would be suitable. For consistency, I'll use MODIS Collection 6 Active Fire product which has data spanning both years. - Collection: 'MODIS/006/MOD14A1' or 'MODIS/061/MOD14A1' - Date: Two periods - 2007 (full year) and 2019 (full year) - Location: Brazil country boundary 2. Masking strategy: Fire detection products already identify fire pixels. I need to count fire detections, not mask them out. The FireMask band or MaxFRP band indicates fire presence. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If images exist and processing succeeds but counts are legitimately 0 or low in one year - C1: If no images found for either year - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If 2019 < 2007 fire detections - B: If 2019 >= 2007 fire detections ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil')) .geometry(); const date2007 = {start: '2007-01-01', end: '2007-12-31'}; const date2019 = {start: '2019-01-01', end: '2019-12-31'}; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const fireCol2007 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(date2007.start, date2007.end) .filterBounds(brazil); const fireCol2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(date2019.start, date2019.end) .filterBounds(brazil); const size2007 = fireCol2007.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = fireCol2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2007 Images: ${size2007}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2007 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels // FireMask band: 0-8 are valid fire classes, 9 is no fire // We'll count pixels where FireMask is between 0 and 8 const countFires = function(collection) { return collection.map(function(img) { const fireMask = img.select('FireMask').lte(8); return img.updateMask(fireMask); }).select('FireMask').sum(); }; const fires2007 = countFires(fireCol2007); const fires2019 = countFires(fireCol2019); // 4. Calculation const count2007 = fires2007.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); const count2019 = fires2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`2007 Fire Detections: ${count2007}`); console.log(`2019 Fire Detections: ${count2019}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2007 === null || count2019 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (count2007 === 0 && count2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid fire pixels detected in either year."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (count2019 < count2007) { console.log("Fewer fires in 2019 than 2007."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Equal or more fires in 2019 than 2007."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
